prompt: A cloud vendor will host our EHR. What must our Business Associate Agreement contain?
assertions: Establishes permitted and required uses/disclosures of PHI and prohibits use beyond the contract or as required by law
Requires appropriate safeguards and compliance with the Security Rule for ePHI
Requires reporting to the covered entity: breaches of unsecured PHI and security incidents (with breach notification timing support for the 60-day clock)
Requires subcontractor flow-down: BAs must obtain the same assurances from subcontractors handling PHI
Return or destruction of PHI at termination where feasible, plus assistance duties (access, amendment, accounting) and termination rights for violations
